items.question: Do owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and gūlī-woman likewise possess knowledge through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate female beings who know through devotion on earth.
This verse adds ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī to that enumeration.
The particle tathā marks these beings as included in the same class.
items.inference: Therefore, owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and gūlī-woman are likewise counted among those who know through devotion.
uncertainties: The exact species or symbolic identity of sararī and gūlī is not specified in the verse.
items.plain_english: Likewise the owl-woman, or indeed the peacock-woman, or the sarari-woman, or the gūlī-woman.
